raw:
Agent Name: Planner

Step Number: 11

Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly interpreted the birth dates of the directors. Jean Yarbrough was born on August 22, 1900, and Takhir Sabirov was born on December 21, 1929. The Planner swapped the birth dates of the directors, mistakenly concluding that Takhir Sabirov was born earlier when, in fact, it was Jean Yarbrough. This error led to the wrong conclusion that "The Last Night of Scheherazade" had the director born first, when it should have been "Leave It to Henry."
